    structure LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.ClosedZigzagResidueCoefficientData {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type x} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, x} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (D : CategoryTheory.Functor (LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ) C) [D.Additive] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear k D] :
    Type u

    Residue maps at vertices together with normalized endpoint-radical coefficients on every path line. No separate endpoint-whiskering axiom is present: it follows from the endpoint-radical kernel and the split residue maps. Consequently the only remaining functorial input is strict span drop for empty-middle cross composites.

          Endpoint-radical coefficients automatically satisfy every whiskering equation whose middle path is an identity. The alternating quiver has no length-two paths, so at most one outer path can be an arrow; the two cases are exactly the left and right endpoint coefficient lemmas.
